name: Pool Exhaustion Heisenbug
essence: A report holds the only slot while waiting for delivery, rejecting another report.

examples.summary: A report holds the only slot while waiting for delivery, rejecting another report.
examples.mechanism: A capacity-one pool keeps its resource across elapsed delivery time; a controlled tick and gate make contention reproducible.
examples.observed_output:
report pool busy at 105
slot held ticks 5
examples.expected_behavior: Both reports complete without rejecting a caller while delivery is pending.

ingredients.suggests: The second caller finds the single resource occupied.
Resource ownership spans a delivery wait while the shared clock advances.

examples.summary: A caller holds the only resource across an awaited delivery, so a later caller finds the pool exhausted..

examples.observed_output:

examples.expected_behavior: Both reports complete after releasing the slot before waiting.

examples.mechanism: The only pool slot remains occupied when a second caller checks capacity. The holder retains ownership across a delivery wait measured by elapsed time.
